title: Fourier regularity of a matrix pushforward
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $H$ be an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^m$. Suppose that for every nonempty set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ with $|S|\le k$, the sum of the columns of $H$ indexed by $S$ is nonzero, and that every nonzero Fourier coefficient of $\phi$ has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$. Then every Fourier coefficient indexed by a nonempty set of at most $k$ coordinates of the sign-cube function corresponding to the pushforward of $\phi$ under $y\mapsto yH$ has absolute value at most $\varepsilon$.
